check.text: RECORD COMPLETE: 99 CHOICES, 12 FIGHTS REPLAYED AND MATCHED

event.name: An Abandoned Forge
event.text: The coals are still warm. A smith could make something better here.

options.label: TEMPER A PIECE
options.text: A common or uncommon piece of yours becomes one of the next rarity, of its kind.

notes: An Abandoned Forge: temper a piece.

event.name: Mercenaries
event.text: A company of sellswords around a crossroads fire. "Coin first."

event.name: A Training Hall
event.text: The sergeant drills anyone who walks in, for free, and hard.

options.label: TAKE THE DRILL
options.text: Three members each learn an ability or train one; everyone loses 15% of max HP.

notes: A Training Hall: take the drill.

event.name: A Prisoner Cart
event.text: A cart with a cage on the back, and an escort of hard-looking guards. The prisoner wears an old company's colours.

options.label: FREE THE PRISONER
options.text: They join you knowing two abilities, and the escort attacks: a hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

notes: A Prisoner Cart: free the prisoner.
Took the Pyre of heroes formation.
The stranger teaches, and moves on.
Room for one more at camp: 3 seats.
Act 2: The Fire Mine. The Giant's Wrath waits at the end.

event.name: The War Table
event.text: A deserted command tent, the maps still pinned to the table.

options.label: STUDY THE MAPS
options.text: A rare formation; everyone loses 10% of max MP (a long night).

notes: The War Table: sell the maps.
Took a tome: the Valkyrie learns Valhalla.

event.name: An Old Soldier
event.text: A grey-haired soldier sharpening a blade by the road. "Still got some fight in me. Or some sense, if you'd rather."

options.label: TAKE HIM IN
options.text: He joins you, knowing two abilities.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Three members each learn an ability or train one; he stays by the road.

event.name: A Blood Shrine
event.text: An altar, a bowl, and something glinting under the stone. The shrine wants blood.

options.label: OFFER BLOOD
options.text: Everyone loses 20% of max HP. A rare piece.

notes.text: Act 1: The Old Road. The Packmaster waits at the end.
